data-astro-cid-pq53vxuo> <p class="intro__text display" data-reveal data-astro-cid-pq53vxuo>A welcoming retreat 50 meters from the beach, where every detail was designed for your rest and peace of mind.</p> <div class="divider-gold intro__line" data-reveal data-delay="2" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-pq53vxuo></div> <p class="intro__place" data-reveal data-delay="3" data-astro-cid-pq53vxuo>Pousada País Tropical is in Icaraizinho, the beach village of Icaraí, in the municipality of Amontada, on the western coast of Ceará. Icaraí de Amontada lies about 190 km from Fortaleza — three hours by road — and two hours from Jericoacoara. The pousada stands 50 metres from the beach, inside the village: you can walk to the sea, to the restaurants and to the kitesurf school without needing a car at any point of your stay.</p> <p class="intro__sub" data-reveal data-delay="4" data-astro-cid-pq53vxuo>50 meters from the beach, 190 km from Fortaleza, with 15 rooms, breakfast included and a 4.7 Google rating.</p> </div> </section>  <section class="about" id="pousada" aria-labelledby="about-title" data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w> <div class="about__inner" data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w> <!-- ── Titre de section centré au-dessus des 2 colonnes ── --> <header class="about__header" data-reveal data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w> <p class="eyebrow about__eyebrow" data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w>The Guesthouse</p> <h2 class="about__title display" id="about-title" data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w>Experiences<br />&amp; Amenities</h2> <div class="divider-gold about__divider" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w></div> </header> <div class="about__layout" data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w> <!-- ── GAUCHE : photo en haut + texte factuel dessous ── --> <div class="about__left" data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w> <div class="about__photo-frame" data-reveal data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w> <img src="/_astro/14082025-DSCF1190.BisbgNWt_ZfGFBI.webp" srcset="/_astro/14082025-DSCF1190.BisbgNWt_20ecrH.webp 480w, /_astro/14082025-DSCF1190.BisbgNWt_1IAQLy.webp 800w" alt="Pousada País Tropical — jardim tropical e piscina" sizes="(max-width: 860px) 90vw, 38vw" loading="lazy" data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w="true" decoding="async" fetchpriority="auto" width="2500" height="3750" class="about__photo"> </div> <p class="about__intro" data-reveal data-astro-cid-x2lc2h5w>País Tropical is located in Icaraizinho de Amontada, on the western coast of Ceará, 50 meters from the beach and 190 km from Fortaleza. class="founder__title" id="founder-title" data-astro-cid-qx4vxpm4> A guesthouse built with love </h2> <div class="founder__divider" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-qx4vxpm4></div> <p class="founder__body" data-astro-cid-qx4vxpm4> Pousada País Tropical was born almost 20 years ago from a simple bet: to create a true retreat in Icaraizinho de Amontada. It started small and grew slowly and carefully — every renovation, every detail of the garden, every breakfast choice made to help guests feel at home. Today it is a passionate team that carries that spirit every day, with deep love for the details and for the encounters the guesthouse makes possible. data-astro-cid-nauxnue6> <p class="eyebrow" data-reveal data-astro-cid-nauxnue6>Location &amp; Kitesurfing</p> <h2 class="location__title display" id="location-title" data-reveal data-delay="2" data-astro-cid-nauxnue6> In the heart of Icaraí de Amontada </h2> <div class="divider-gold location__divider" data-reveal data-delay="3" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-nauxnue6></div> <div class="location__kite-icon" data-reveal data-delay="3" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-nauxnue6> <svg></svg> </div> <p class="location__body" data-reveal data-delay="4" data-astro-cid-nauxnue6>Icaraí de Amontada is the official name of the beach and the district; Icaraizinho is what everyone calls the village. The pousada sits right in the middle of it, 50 metres from the sea, three hours from Fortaleza along the western coast of Ceará.</p> <p class="location__body" data-reveal data-delay="5" data-astro-cid-nauxnue6>Icaraizinho de Amontada is one of Brazil’s most sought-after spots for kitesurf and wingfoil, with steady winds from July to January. The <a href="https://www.kiteclubicaraizinho.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Cabana do Kite</a> is just minutes away — with lessons, equipment rental and organised downwinds. Jericoacoara is about 2h away and Fortaleza 3h by car.</p> <p class="location__guide" data-reveal data-delay="6" data-astro-cid-nauxnue6> <a href="/en/icarai-de-amontada" class="location__guide-link" data-astro-cid-nauxnue6>Complete guide to Icaraí de Amontada →</a> </p> </div> </div> </section>  <section class="testimonials section section--dark" aria-labelledby="testimonials-title" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x> <div class="container" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x> <header class="testimonials__header" data-reveal data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x> <p class="eyebrow" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x>Avaliações</p> <h2 class="testimonials__title display" id="testimonials-title" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x>What our guests say</h2> <p class="testimonials__subtitle" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x>4.7 · 280 reviews on Google</p> <div class="divider-gold" style="margin: 1.4rem auto 0" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x></div> </header> <div class="testimonials__grid" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x> <article class="tm-card" data-reveal data-delay="1" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x> <div class="tm-card__stars" role="img" aria-label="Avaliação 5 de 5 estrelas" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x> <span aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x>★★★★★</span> </div> <blockquote class="tm-card__quote" data-astro-cid-zzqkys7x>Ambiente aconchegante, com muita natureza e um toque elegante do luxo. We serve fresh fruit, natural juices, breads, cakes, eggs, tapioca and other options prepared daily so you can start your day at ease.</p> </div> </details><details class="faq__item" data-reveal data-delay="1" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> <summary class="faq__question" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> Does the guesthouse have a pool? <span class="faq__icon" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> <svg></svg> </span> </summary> <div class="faq__answer" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> <p data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx>Yes. Our pool is integrated into the tropical garden and is one of the guests&#39; favourite spots for relaxing after the beach or a day of sightseeing.</p> </div> </details><details class="faq__item" data-reveal data-delay="2" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> <summary class="faq__question" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> Does the guesthouse have a restaurant? <span class="faq__icon" aria-hidden="true" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> <svg></svg> </span> </summary> <div class="faq__answer" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> <p data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx>Yes. Restaurante País Tropical is open to both guests and visitors and offers dishes inspired by local cuisine, fresh seafood, vegetarian options and a pleasant setting for lunch or dinner.</p> </div> </details> </div> <div class="faq__footer" data-reveal data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx> <a href="/en/faq" class="btn btn-gold-outline" data-astro-cid-hqz3ghsx>View all questions</a> </div> </div> </section>  <section class="region-map" id="regiao" aria-label="Mapa da região — Pousada País Tropical" data-astro-cid-t6stw2la> <img src="/_astro/mapa-regiao.JB0DgpTl_snQXF.webp" srcset="/_astro/mapa-regiao.JB0DgpTl_1kIhXc.webp 800w, /_astro/mapa-regiao.JB0DgpTl_NgKr0.webp 1200w, /_astro/mapa-regiao.JB0DgpTl_snQXF.webp 1796w" alt="Mapa da região: Pousada País Tropical em Icaraí de Amontada, litoral oeste do Ceará — a 100 km de Jericoacoara e 190 km de Fortaleza, entre Barra Grande, Tatajuba, Preá, Ilha do Guajiru e Cumbuco." sizes="100vw" loading="lazy" data-astro-cid-t6stw2la="true" decoding="async" fetchpriority="auto" width="1796" height="876" class="region-map__img"> </section>  </main> <footer class="footer" id="footer" aria-label="Rodapé" data-astro-cid-sz7xmlte> <div class="footer__inner container" data-astro-cid-sz7xmlte> <!-- Row 1: brand + tagline --> <div class="footer__brand" data-astro-cid-sz7xmlte> <p class="footer__name display" data-astro-cid-sz7xmlte>PAÍS TROPICAL</p> <p class="footer__tagline" data-astro-cid-sz7xmlte>Guesthouse in Icaraizinho de Amontada · Ceará · Brazil</p> <div class="footer__socials" data-astro-cid-sz7xmlte> <a href="https://www.instagram.com/pousadapaistropical/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="footer__social" aria-label="Instagram" data-astro-cid-sz7xmlte> <svg></svg>
